findings.claim: Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false); the learning window is [0.0,0.5] with terminal score time 0.99 and terminal state time 1.0, so no final-affinity benefit can be computed. Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity, and must not be presented as final affinity benefit.

Survival enrichment is weak and mostly null: landmark_00_soft_mass (0.365, q=0.120), landmark_07_soft_mass (0.220, q=0.356), landmark_10_soft_mass (0.234, q=0.302), landmark_18_local_czz (0.217, q=0.302), landmark_02_local_dz (0.206, q=0.356), landmark_04_local_czz (0.266, q=0.302). Negative survival signals appear for local_czz at landmarks 05, 09, 14, 15 and local_cyy at 07, 16, 19. All q-values exceed 0.05, so no survival field survives multiplicity adjustment.

Endpoint effects disagree with survival credit in direction and strength. Strong positive endpoint effects: pair_kernel_1.5 (0.562, q=1.5e-4), pair_kernel_2.5 (0.631, q=2.2e-5), pair_kernel_3.5 (0.540, q=9.8e-5), pair_kernel_5.0 (0.319, q=0.0037), landmark_00_occupancy3 (0.545, q=2.4e-4), landmark_02_softmin (0.253, q=0.0046), landmark_03_softmin (0.360, q=0.0127), landmark_05_softmin (0.396, q=0.0029), landmark_06_softmin (0.294, q=6.8e-4), landmark_12_softmin (0.335, q=0.0123), landmark_15_softmin (0.369, q=0.0037), landmark_18_softmin (0.264, q=0.0060). Strong negative: shape_xx (-0.495, q=8.1e-4), shape_yy (-0.513, q=1.5e-5), pair_kernel_7.0 (-0.485, q=1.5e-4), landmark_00_softmin (-0.481, q=8.1e-4), global_centroid_y (-0.243, q=0.0136), shape_yz (-0.212, q=0.0347). The pair-kernel sign flips between 5.0 A (positive) and 7.0 A (negative), so direction priorities differ from survival ranking.

Parent-child increment contrasts are largely null after multiplicity adjustment: only landmark_00_softmin (q=0.046) and landmark_00_occupancy3 (q=0.081) approach significance; shape_xx (q=0.095), shape_yy (q=0.161), shape_xz (q=0.207), pair_kernel_2.5 (q=0.208), pair_kernel_7.0 (q=0.208), landmark_03_occupancy5 (q=0.161), landmark_01_occupancy5 (q=0.227), landmark_16_occupancy3 (q=0.222) are not significant. Within-path change evidence is therefore weak.

Turnover accounting shows large positive turnover_residual_rate for local_cxx at landmarks 00, 04, 07, 08, 13, 16, 17, 19 and local_cyy at 00, 01, 04, 07, 08, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 19, with edge_rate negative and population_rate near zero. The residual is an accounting diagnostic that includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity.

Joint diagnostics show joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A are negative under both raw and adjusted covariance (e.g., adjusted_covariance joint_innovation_RMS_A -3.6e-5, q=0.020; joint_internal_RMS_A -3.4e-5, q=0.030; adjusted_correlation -0.150, q=2.8e-4 and -0.137, q=9.7e-4). Pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 remain positive after adjustment (adjusted_covariance 7.7e-7, q=0.081 and 1.1e-6, q=0.077; adjusted_correlation 0.101, q=0.019 and 0.084, q=0.046). Shape_yy is negative after adjustment (adjusted_correlation -0.100, q=0.015).

Global centroid coordinates are not supported: raw_covariance global_centroid_x/y/z have q=0.72, 0.69, 0.97; adjusted_covariance q=0.97, 0.86, 0.91; raw_correlation q=0.87, 0.40, 0.24; adjusted_correlation q=0.81, 0.74, 0.53. No global translation direction is supported.

Continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolations over support [0.0,0.49] with no extrapolation allowed; polynomial fits are rejected (polynomial_accepted=false) and relative_node_RMSE ranges roughly 0.28-0.99. Sign changes are frequent (e.g., 4-13 per feature) and strong_sign_conflicts are common, so a constant rule is not supported over a time-conditioned rule; the contrast curve is not an absolute reward target.

Curve fidelity audit shows last_empirical_z and last_fit_z frequently disagree in sign (e.g., landmark_00_occupancy3 empirical -0.040 vs fit 0.545; landmark_00_softmin -0.146 vs -0.481; landmark_02_occupancy5 0.142 vs -0.323; landmark_02_softmin -0.188 vs 0.253; landmark_04_occupancy5 -0.103 vs 0.300; landmark_06_softmin -0.402 vs 0.294; landmark_16_occupancy5 0.315 vs -0.175; landmark_18_occupancy5 0.294 vs -0.311; landmark_18_softmin -0.370 vs 0.264; pair_kernel_1.5 0.101 vs -0.349; pair_kernel_2.5 0.043 vs -0.469; pair_kernel_3.5 0.055 vs -0.490; pair_kernel_5.0 -0.047 vs -0.532; shape_xx -0.062 vs -0.495; shape_yy 0.163 vs -0.513). Legendre runtime is not allowed.

Information audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A 0.081 (CI 0.070-0.092), compressed_choice_fixed_RMS_A 0.564 (CI 0.499-0.620), compressed_choice_proper_rigid_RMS_A 0.529 (CI 0.468-0.582), top4_teacher_overlap 0.470 (CI 0.427-0.515), compressed_chosen_teacher_score_correlation 0.102 (CI 0.065-0.140), full_chosen_teacher_score_correlation 0.064 (CI 0.021-0.103). Joint diagnostics show selection_innovation/observed_child_score_gain is negative (-0.036, q=1.8e-7) while teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment is positive (0.226, q=2.2e-9). Teacher contrast is dominated by internal fraction (0.787) with translation 0.132 and rotation 0.081.

Pair-kernel 1.5 and 2.5 A are the most reproducible positive coordinate signals: adjusted_covariance pair_kernel_1.5 7.7e-7 (q=0.081, same_sign_batch_fraction 0.786), pair_kernel_2.5 1.1e-6 (q=0.077, 0.786); adjusted_correlation 0.101 (q=0.019, 0.929) and 0.084 (q=0.046, 0.929); raw_correlation 0.085 (q=0.027, 0.857) and 0.088 (q=0.041, 0.857). Pair_kernel_7.0 is negative (adjusted_correlation -0.050, q=0.129; raw_correlation -0.055, q=0.095).

hypotheses.claim: A coordinate intervention that increases pair-distance shell density near 1.5-2.5 A (pair_kernel_1.5, pair_kernel_2.5) while avoiding the 7.0 A shell is the most reproducible positive endpoint direction; observable is the pair_kernel scalar, intended response is increased endpoint contrast, target origin is the endpoint pointcloud, scale is 1.5-2.5 A, and a discriminating failure is a null or reversed endpoint effect with same_sign_batch_fraction below 0.5.

A coordinate intervention that reduces shape_yy (and shape_xx, shape_yz) is supported by negative endpoint effects and negative adjusted correlations; observable is the shape tensor entry, intended response is reduced endpoint contrast, target origin is the endpoint pointcloud, scale is the molecular shape extent, and a discriminating failure is a positive adjusted correlation with same_sign_batch_fraction above 0.5.

A landmark-local intervention that increases soft_mass and local_dy at landmarks 00, 02, 06, 07, 09, 10, 14, 17, 18 while decreasing landmark_00_softmin is supported by endpoint and regional enrichment; observable is the landmark soft_mass/local_dy/softmin, intended response is increased endpoint contrast, target origin is the landmark region, scale is the 5 A radius, and a discriminating failure is a null regional enrichment with q above 0.05.

A time-conditioned regional attention rule using validated absolute contrast changes at actual score nodes is supported over a constant rule because continuous contrasts show frequent sign changes and fit fidelity is low; observable is the observed-node contrast, intended response is time-varying regional attention, target origin is the static teacher coordinates, scale is the learning window [0.0,0.5], and a discriminating failure is a constant-sign contrast with relative_node_RMSE below 0.35.

The large positive turnover_residual_rate for local_cxx and local_cyy is consistent with changing cohort composition and score reclassification rather than within-path change, because edge_rate is negative and population_rate is near zero; observable is the turnover residual, intended response is accounting of composition change, target origin is the parent-child increment, scale is the whole window, and a discriminating failure is a positive population_rate with a null residual.

Joint innovation and internal RMS are negative after adjustment while teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment is positive, suggesting that reducing joint internal motion while aligning to teacher contrast is a testable direction; observable is joint_internal_RMS_A and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment, intended response is reduced internal RMS with increased alignment, target origin is the joint selector, scale is the endpoint pointcloud, and a discriminating failure is a positive adjusted joint_internal_RMS_A with same_sign_batch_fraction below 0.5.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
Pair kernels, moment effects and turnover rates are diagnostic evidence only; the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters; no temperature edit is proposed.
